item.title: After patient deaths, Idaho budget committee approves restoring cut Medicaid mental health programs
item.description: The Idaho Legislature will consider a bill to restore Medicaid mental health treatment programs that the state cut to comply with the governor’s order for budget cuts. item.title: Idaho Senate to consider bill that would criminalize trans people using preferred bathrooms
item.description: The Idaho Senate is one of the last stops for a bill that would criminalize “willfully” entering public and government bathrooms and changing rooms designated for another sex. item.title: Idaho Senate passes $22M in Medicaid disability budget cuts, sending bill to governor

item.title: Idaho’s America250 leaders neglected to formally include tribes in celebration until asked
